pairs.falsifiable: Mg+Sn equal 1% co-dope at 973 K: the DEEP acceptor (Mg) is marginally less ionized than the shallow donor, leaving a slight donor excess -> lightly n-type/RESISTIVE E_F=3.09 eV (well above intrinsic 2.52, NOT p-type). MACE E_assoc=-0.54 eV => ~87% of dopants form BOUND NEUTRAL donor-acceptor pairs (detectable by DAP photoluminescence / EXAFS Mg-Sn correlation); pairing removes donors+acceptors EQUALLY so E_F barely shifts (3.08) but the carrier-active fraction drops ~87%. FALSIFIED if equal donor+deep-acceptor co-doping turns p-type / strongly conductive, OR no DAP/EXAFS pairing signature appears. To reach semi-insulating, acceptor must EXCEED donor (deep acceptor under-ionizes).

(2) ~85-92% of equal co-dopants form bound NEUTRAL donor-acceptor pairs at growth T (MACE E_assoc~-0.55 eV); pairing removes donors+acceptors equally so E_F is nearly unchanged but the carrier-active dopant fraction drops sharply. E_bind from MACE-MP-0 NEUTRAL relaxation = lower bound on charged binding (HSE06 needed, research B.1); sputter is low-T/non-equilibrium so realized pairing may be below this equilibrium limit.
